ms.promise: We create a completely new betting ADABet platform based on the Cardano blockchain combined. This platform will bring the property ownership experience to players, and the right to preserve the identity of bettors, it is really useful on a betting platform that needs to ensure the highest reputation. In the future, the development team is ambitious: the ADABET platform has the ability to replace the current betting platforms. The user's digital assets are integrated in the user's ADA wallet and transacted on the Cardano blockchain network. This ensures safety, decentralization, and fast deposits and withdrawals.The ADABET.IO DAPP is bringing more investors to hold ADA through our platform, attracting a lot of new investors to Cardano as well as many betting transactions on ADABET. Transactions are completely on the Cardano blockchain so ensuring customer identity is the benefit of this platform. The project contributes to the richness of Cardano’s dApp ecosystem as well as new experiences for ADA fans.
